Stay Centered: the playhead stays still and the timeline moves during playback/scrubbing.
Moving (Legacy Mode): the timeline stays at its scroll position and the playhead moves with time.
Active • the workspace follows the composition colours with ±2 second sampling and ±2.4 second transitions. Editor UI only; export is unaffected.

Editor Ambient is off. Turn it on to make the workspace colours follow the composition with periodic sampling and slow transitions; the effect is editor UI only and never enters the export. The choice is saved on this device.

Strong: every frame must enter the cache before the timeline advances. Uncached areas may slow down and go silent so audio does not drift; when the playhead returns to a ready cached area, audio plays in sync automatically.
Semi Strong: every missing frame gets a short window for an exact seek + capture. Playback may slow slightly and audio may pause briefly, but a single heavy frame cannot stall playback indefinitely.

Realtime Catch-Up: the playhead and audio stay real-time. B-frame-safe pre-render runs as a sequential cursor behind the playhead; on a slow device the green line falls behind instead of jumping ahead and leaving gaps. The worker keeps catching up to the part of the timeline already passed.

Normal: playback and audio stay real-time, but frames entering pre-render are decoded through the same sequential presentation-order pipeline as Strong/Record so B-frame video is safe. If the decoder cannot keep up, cached frames may be skipped without slowing playback.
Classic: every cached frame stays a raw ImageBitmap. Lightest on CPU, but far heavier on RAM and old frames are evicted once the limit is reached.
Lossless: frames near the playhead stay ImageBitmap, distant frames are compressed as lossless PNG. Cached FPS/pixel quality stays the same, using less RAM at the cost of extra CPU.
